Several of the individuals had congregated toward the center, collectively forming a much larger Guy Fawkes mask. The many had become one...but the edges were not defined. In fact, the further away from the center of the mask one went, the further away each individual was from another. It portrayed the idea (I think) that anonymous really could be anyone. Its purpose was driven by its ranks and its ranks were driven by purpose.

Now imagine that each one of those individuals wearing guy fawkes mask were themselves only made up of individuals wearing guy fawkes masks. I’m going to refer to the individual made up of individuals as a “collective individual” or Ci for short. Just as the edges of the large guy fawkes mask blur, so too does the Ci’s figure, with some individuals showing stronger convictions than others toward the purpose uniting that Ci in the first place.

But in order to drive that Ci away, against, neutral or toward that center mask (or any mask) requires coordination that purpose in of itself cannot necessarily provide. The Ci needs eyes and ears to, not necessarily direct the body but, provide information in real time so that a plan of action (or non action) can be formed between the individuals within the Ci. The plan better be good too or large portions of the Ci’s body could dissolve and align with another or new Ci.

I’m of the opinion that a Ci would also need a mouth, a way to communicate as one with other Ci’s or with the center mask as a whole in a clear and concise manner...but if corruption were to poison the Ci, the likelihood that it would start with the mouth is pretty strong.
